prompts.scene: He wears an oatmeal cotton T-shirt and relaxed dark trousers and sits at a small breakfast table in a lived-in kitchen, arranging toast on a ceramic plate. The camera occupies the eye-level position of a companion seated across the table about 1.4 meters away. Hearing the companion ask to see the plate, he pauses, raises his gaze toward the person just behind the lens and leans forward slightly to listen. One hand remains in natural contact with the plate as he slides it a short distance toward the shared middle of the table. His shoulders stay relaxed and his expression is attentive, with a brief expectant pause rather than a fixed smile. The gaze, orientation and interrupted action make the exchange visible. A casual phone photograph with an intended 35 mm-equivalent view, slightly off-center framing and enough depth of field to read the room. Soft side window light and a small warm practical lamp, realistic skin and fabric texture, no studio polish. One visible person; the photographer remains outside the frame, with no selfie arm or extra hand.
